title: Agentech Launches AI Education Program at Learning Tree Campus
author: Agentech
excerpt: Upcoming Robot Dog Curriculum Brings AI and Robotics Learning to Life
body: In June 2026, the Agentech AI Education Team officially launched its AI learning program at Learning Tree, combining artificial intelligence education with the company’s upcoming Robot Dog Curriculum to provide students with an immersive technology learning experience.

Centered around the theme of “AI + Robotics,” the program introduced students to cutting-edge technologies through interactive lessons, hands-on activities, and live robotics demonstrations. Students had the opportunity to explore the fundamentals of artificial intelligence while engaging directly with robotic systems and intelligent interactions.

Throughout the program, students demonstrated remarkable enthusiasm and curiosity. They actively participated in classroom activities, eagerly explored new concepts, and embraced challenges with excitement and confidence. The experience helped students develop not only an understanding of AI concepts, but also critical thinking, problem-solving skills, creativity, and teamwork.

This program represents another important step in Agentech’s mission to bring innovative AI and robotics education into real-world learning environments. The upcoming Robot Dog Curriculum will further integrate artificial intelligence, robotics control, computer vision, and practical applications, providing students with a comprehensive project-based learning experience that empowers them to become creators of technology rather than simply users of it.

Agentech remains committed to advancing AI and robotics education through partnerships with schools, educational organizations, and community programs. By making emerging technologies accessible to young learners, Agentech aims to inspire the next generation of innovators, engineers, and future leaders.
At Agentech, we believe that education is not only about acquiring knowledge—it is about fostering curiosity, creativity, and the skills needed to thrive in a technology-driven future.

zh.title: Agentech AI课程正式落地 Learning Tree校园
zh.excerpt: 机器狗课程即将上线，开启AI与机器人教育新体验
body: 2026年6月，Agentech AI教育团队正式走进 Learning Tree 校园，将人工智能课程与即将发布的机器狗课程相结合，为学生们带来沉浸式AI与机器人学习体验。
本次课程以“AI + Robotics”为主题，通过互动教学、实践体验和机器人展示，让学生们近距离感受人工智能与机器人技术的魅力。课堂上，小朋友们热情满满、积极参与，在老师的引导下学习AI基础知识，并通过实际操作体验机器人控制与智能交互。
在课程过程中，孩子们展现出极高的专注度与学习热情。每个孩子都认真投入课堂活动，积极探索科技世界，脸上洋溢着兴奋与成就感。学生们不仅学习了人工智能的基础概念，更在实践中培养了创新思维、逻辑能力以及解决问题的能力。
此次课程也是Agentech机器人教育体系的重要实践。即将推出的机器狗课程将进一步融合人工智能、机器人控制、计算机视觉以及真实应用场景，为学生提供更加系统化、项目化的学习体验，让孩子们从科技体验者成长为科技创造者。
Agentech始终致力于推动AI教育与机器人科技在校园中的落地应用。未来，公司将持续与学校、教育机构及社区合作，为更多学生提供接触前沿科技的机会，帮助下一代建立面向未来的创新能力与科技素养。
我们相信，未来教育不仅是知识的传授，更是创造力、探索精神与科技能力的培养。Agentech将继续以创新教育为使命，连接科技与未来。

title: Agentech, FF, and Learning Tree Hold Strategic Meetings to Advance Robotics and AI Education Collaboration
author: Li Yang
excerpt: Following Agentech’s company restructuring and strategic transition into an AI-native organization, Agentech recently held a series of important meetings with Faraday Future (FF) and Learning Tree to explore future collaboration opportunities in robotics technology, AI education, and intelligent systems development.
body: During the first meeting, FF’s VP and CTO visited Agentech for in-depth discussions focused on robotics technologies, intelligent agent systems, AI-native educational frameworks, and future technology learning environments. Both sides exchanged ideas on AI infrastructure, robotics applications, curriculum development, and the integration of intelligent systems into real-world educational scenarios. The meeting established strong alignment between the two teams and laid an important foundation for future cooperation.

Following the discussions with FF, Agentech and Learning Tree — an existing long-term educational partner of Agentech — organized a three-party strategic meeting together with the FF team. During the meeting, all parties conducted friendly and productive discussions surrounding robotics education, AI curriculum implementation, future innovation labs, and the commercialization potential of intelligent technologies within educational environments.
The meetings further strengthened the shared vision among the three organizations and ultimately helped facilitate the official collaboration that followed shortly afterward.

Agentech believes that the future of education will be deeply connected with AI, robotics, and intelligent systems. By combining advanced technologies with real-world learning experiences, the company aims to help students not only learn about AI, but also directly interact with the technologies shaping the future.

As Agentech continues expanding its collaborations with industry and educational partners, the company remains committed to building AI-native learning ecosystems that bridge technology, education, and practical innovation.

zh.title: Agentech、FF 与 Learning Tree 举行战略会议，推进机器人与人工智能教育合作
zh.excerpt: 在 Agentech 完成公司重组并正式迈向 AI Native（AI 原生）发展方向之后，公司近期与 Faraday Future（FF）以及长期教育合作伙伴 Learning Tree 举行了多场重要战略会议，共同探讨机器人技术、AI 教育以及智能系统未来的发展合作。
body: 在首次会议中，FF 的 VP 与 CTO 来到 Agentech 公司，与团队围绕机器人技术、智能体系统（Agent Systems）、AI 原生教育框架以及未来科技学习场景进行了深入交流。双方重点讨论了 AI 基础设施、机器人应用、课程研发以及智能系统在真实教育环境中的落地可能性，并在多个方向上达成了高度共识，为后续合作奠定了重要基础。
随后，在与 FF 完成深入沟通后，Agentech 联合长期合作伙伴 Learning Tree，与 FF 团队共同举行了三方战略会议。会议期间，三方围绕机器人教育、AI 课程体系建设、未来创新实验室以及智能技术在教育领域中的商业化应用等方向展开了积极且富有成效的讨论。
此次系列会议进一步加强了三方之间的合作愿景，并最终推动了后续正式合作关系的达成。
Agentech 始终认为，未来教育将与人工智能、机器人以及智能系统深度融合。公司希望通过将先进技术与真实学习场景结合，让学生不仅学习 AI 知识，更能够真正接触、理解并参与未来科技的发展过程。
未来，Agentech 也将继续联合产业与教育合作伙伴，共同推动 AI 原生学习生态、机器人实践平台以及智能教育创新的发展。

title: Agentech Participates in the First Shenzhen Association of America Business Resource Networking Conference
author: Li Yang
excerpt: On June 7, 2026, Agentech’s leadership team participated in the First Business Resource Networking Conference organized by the Shenzhen Association of America, joining more than 130 entrepreneurs, investors, and industry leaders from across Southern California.
body: The event focused on resource sharing, collaboration, and business development, bringing together professionals from technology, education, healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and international trade sectors. Throughout the conference, 20 companies presented their projects and business opportunities, creating a dynamic environment for networking and partnership development.

As a company dedicated to AI education, robotics technology, and international education initiatives, Agentech engaged in meaningful discussions with business leaders, industry experts, and investment professionals. Key topics included AI education deployment, robotics innovation, international collaboration, and future talent development.

Participation in this event further expanded Agentech’s professional network and strengthened relationships with industry partners, opening new opportunities for collaboration, innovation, and growth.
Agentech remains committed to building connections across industries and creating meaningful partnerships that advance AI education, robotics technology, and the development of future innovators.

zh.title: Agentech受邀参加美国深圳联合会首届企业资源对接会
zh.excerpt: 2026年6月7日，Agentech核心管理团队受邀参加美国深圳联合会首届企业资源对接会，与来自南加州地区130余位企业家、投资人及行业代表共同交流合作。
body: 本次活动以资源共享、合作共赢为主题，汇聚了来自科技、教育、金融、医疗、制造业及国际贸易等多个领域的优秀企业家。活动期间，20位企业代表进行了项目路演和资源展示，现场交流深入、合作氛围浓厚。
作为一家专注于人工智能教育、机器人技术研发及国际教育项目的创新企业，Agentech团队与多位企业家、行业专家及投资机构代表进行了深入交流，围绕AI教育落地、机器人产业发展、国际教育合作以及未来科技人才培养等议题展开探讨。
通过本次活动，Agentech进一步拓展了企业资源网络，加强了与各行业优秀企业之间的联系，为未来项目合作、产业资源整合及科技教育创新创造了更多可能性。
未来，Agentech将继续积极参与各类行业交流活动，与更多合作伙伴携手，共同推动人工智能教育、机器人科技和创新人才培养的发展。

title: On 2026.05.22, Agentech is honored to officially announce a strategic collaboration with  Faraday Future (FF) and  Learning Tree to jointly advance robotics development, AI-native education, and next-generation intelligent ecosystems.
author: Wang Yuan
excerpt: As part of the partnership, the three parties have formally signed a cooperation agreement and launched the first batch of robotics and robotic dog equipment procurement.
body: As part of the partnership, the three parties have formally signed a cooperation agreement and launched the first batch of robotics and robotic dog equipment procurement. This marks an important milestone for Agentech in integrating AI infrastructure, embodied intelligence, and real-world educational applications.

Leveraging Agentech’s strengths in AI agents, vision intelligence, and educational technology, together with FF’s robotics and intelligent hardware ecosystem, the collaboration aims to accelerate the deployment of AI-powered experiences into real learning and consumer environments.

During the graduation ceremony held later that day, the debut appearance of the robots and robotic dogs became one of the highlights of the event. Students experienced firsthand the excitement and inspiration brought by future technologies, transforming AI education from abstract concepts into tangible interaction.
Together, Agentech, FF, and Learning Tree look forward to embracing the opportunities of the AI era and building the future of intelligent industry and education. 🚀

title: Agentech Visits FF Headquarters
author: Li Yang
excerpt: Exploring the Future of AI, Robotics, and Education Integration
body: On May 18, 2026, the Agentech team was invited to visit the headquarters of Faraday Future (FF) for an in-depth exchange focused on AI technology development, robotics applications, and the integration of education and intelligent technologies.

During the visit, both parties discussed robotics technology, intelligent agent systems, AI-native education frameworks, and future educational application scenarios. Drawing on Agentech’s experience in AI development, curriculum design, and educational implementation, the two teams explored multiple possibilities for future collaboration.

The discussions also focused on robotics commercialization, the integration of AI and education, and the development of future-oriented technology learning environments. Both sides reached strong alignment on jointly advancing AI education programs, robotics practice applications, and innovative educational initiatives.

Agentech stated that it will continue promoting the deep integration of AI technology, robotics, and education, enabling students not only to learn knowledge, but also to engage directly with future technologies, understand the AI-driven world, and participate in real-world projects and practical applications.
This visit also established a solid foundation for further collaboration between the two parties in robotics technology, AI education, and innovation lab initiatives.

title: Agentech Begins a New Chapter as an AI-Native Company
author: Agentech
excerpt: March 16, 2026 marks the official beginning of Agentech's journey as an AI-native company built for the future.
body: March 16, 2026 marks more than the opening of a new office - it marks the official beginning of Agentech's journey as an AI-native company built for the future.

As artificial intelligence rapidly evolves beyond traditional software and becomes capable of perception, reasoning, and autonomous action, Agentech was founded with a clear vision: to help shape the next generation of intelligent systems that will transform how people learn, work, and live.

We believe the future will not belong to companies that simply use AI as a tool, but to organizations that are fundamentally designed around AI from the very beginning. At Agentech, AI is not an add-on - it is part of our core identity, culture, and long-term mission.

This milestone represents the start of a new era where innovation moves faster, intelligent agents become real-world collaborators, and technology becomes more human-centered than ever before. Our mission is to bridge education, intelligence, and action - creating systems that empower people and unlock new possibilities for the future.
As we celebrated this important moment together, we were reminded that we are not simply witnessing the AI revolution. We are building within it.
The future has already begun - and Agentech is proud to be part of creating it.

zh.title: Agentech 以 AI 原生公司身份开启新篇章
zh.excerpt: 2026 年 3 月 16 日，标志着 Agentech 作为面向未来的 AI 原生公司正式开启新的旅程。
body: 2026 年 3 月 16 日，不仅是新办公室启用的日子，更标志着 Agentech 作为一家面向未来的 AI 原生公司正式开启新的旅程。
随着人工智能迅速超越传统软件，逐渐具备感知、推理和自主行动能力，Agentech 以清晰的愿景创立：帮助塑造下一代智能系统，改变人们学习、工作和生活的方式。
我们相信，未来不属于那些只是把 AI 当作工具使用的公司，而属于从一开始就围绕 AI 进行设计和构建的组织。在 Agentech，AI 不是附加项，而是我们核心身份、文化和长期使命的一部分。
这一里程碑代表着新时代的开始：创新将以更快速度推进，智能体将成为现实世界中的协作者，技术也将比以往更加以人为本。我们的使命是连接教育、智能与行动，创造能够赋能人们并释放未来新可能的系统。
在我们共同庆祝这一重要时刻时，我们再次意识到，我们并不只是见证 AI 革命，而是在其中亲手建设它。
未来已经开始，Agentech 很自豪能够参与创造这一未来。
